newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba, Venezuela sign investment protection accord.
newsitem.headline: Cuba, Venezuela sign investment protection accord.

text.p: Cuba and Venezuela on Wednesday signed an investment protection and promotion accord, as well as agreements on scientific and cultural cooperation.

The documents were signed by visiting Foreign Minister Miguel Angel Burelli and his Cuban counterpart Roberto Robaina. Burelli began a three-day visit to Cuba on Tuesday and will attend a meeting of ministers from the Association of Caribbean States, which starts on Thursday.
The investment promotion and protection accord is similar to investment agreements that communist-ruled Cuba now has with nearly 20 countries as it seeks to attract foreign capital.
Burelli said after the signing he hoped the agreements would be a step towards closer ties between two countries that he said have much in common culturally.

There is little Venezuelan investment in Cuba. But according to Venezuelan officials bilateral trade this year will be around $300 million, mostly in Venezuelan exports of oil and oil products. Cuba seeks to redress the balance with sales of goods such as medical products.
